{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are consistently below true outcomes, showing a persistent lag that narrows as dates approach",
    "The gap between forecast and reality is largest at 30-day horizon and decreases to near-zero at 1-day ahead",
    "High sentiment (>=0.67) in history correlates with higher true prices than the model predicts",
    "Model under-forecasts prices during sentiment bullish periods by approximately 1-2 currency units",
    "When price history shows a clear downtrend, model forecasts are too low relative to mean reversion",
    "Sentiment turning from negative to positive leads to faster price recovery than model anticipates",
    "Model fails to fully capture the momentum embedded in sentiment transitions"
] }
